svg.title: 99.99%: Your machines, on AWS
svg.desc: Player reference for a developed in-game company. Users reach an Application Load Balancer, which distributes traffic to Amazon EC2 app servers. The app servers look up reads in Amazon ElastiCache and send writes and cache misses to Amazon RDS. Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling adds and removes servers. Amazon CloudWatch represents the monitoring wall. Dashed lines show controls and metrics, outside the request path.
